name: ListPolicySetAttachedGateways

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy set. The name must be unique within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 策略集（PolicySet）的名称，在当前阿里云账号下唯一
parameters.name: policy_set_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used for pagination. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. For subsequent calls, pass the NextToken value returned from the previous call
parameters.help_zh: 用于翻页的 Token，首次调用时无需传入；后续调用透传上一次返回值中的 NextToken 即可
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The gateway type. Valid values:

AIGateway: Alibaba Cloud AI Gateway
AgentRunMCP: AgentRun MCP tool

Default value: AIGateway
parameters.help_zh:
网关类型。取值：

AIGateway（阿里云AI网关）。
AgentRunMCP（AgentRun MCP工具）。

不传时默认为AIGateway
parameters.name: gateway_type

AttachedPolicySetName.description_en: The name of the policy set that is currently in effect on the gateway
AttachedPolicySetName.description_zh: 当前网关上实际生效的策略集名称

AttachedTime.description_en: The time when the policy set was attached to the gateway, in UTC and ISO 8601 format
AttachedTime.description_zh: 策略集挂载到网关的时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

EnforcementMode.description_en:
The policy enforcement mode. Valid values:

ENFORCE: Blocks non-compliant requests and allows compliant requests.
LOG_ONLY: Only logs non-compliant requests without blocking them

GatewayArn.description_en: The ARN of the target gateway

AIGateway: Alibaba Cloud AI Gateway
AgentRunMCP: AgentRun MCP tool
